Therianthrope

A Therianthrope carries the curse of the werebeast, a slow transformation of body and instinct that grants power at the price of control. The curse spreads through its bite beneath the light of the Planar Tear.

Therianthrope DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.

The curse spreads through the natural weapons marked with "spreads the curse" in your branch's form descriptions below. When you hit a creature with one of them, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or become cursed. Unless the curse is removed before the next Planar Tear, the target gains Stage 1 of the Therianthrope advancement class.

Advancement Table

StageNameFeaturesControl PointsWild RegenerationKey Ability
1AfflictedBestial Flaw, Therianthrope Branch, Unwilling Transformation--14
2SavageControl Points, Controlling the Curse, Wild Regeneration (while transformed)11d414
3FeralFlaw Mitigation I, Bestial Aspect11d414
4PrimalFlaw Mitigation II, Feral Speed, Empowered Transformation I21d616
5AdaptedFlaw Mitigation III, branch feature21d616
6AwakenedFlaw Mitigation IV, Empowered Transformation II31d816
7PackbornFlaw Mitigation V, branch feature31d818
8AlphaFlaw Mitigation VI, Empowered Transformation III, Predator's Resurgence41d1018
9DireFlaw Mitigation VII, branch feature41d1018
10ApexFlaw Mitigation VIII52d620

Stage Features

Stage 1: Bestial Flaw

The curse affects both mind and body. Choose one of the following flaws: Dominance; Violent; Timidity; Nightmares; Possessive; The Hunt; Restlessness; Feral; Picky Eater; Paranoia.

Stage 1: Therianthrope Branch

Choose the branch of your curse: Bear, Fox, Raven, Tiger, Shark, Snake, or Wolf, determined by the Therianthrope that cursed you. Your branch determines your Animal Form and Hybrid Form, your key ability, your alignment while transformed, and your branch features.

Stage 1: Unwilling Transformation

The curse overwhelms your body at times of great stress, or when the moon is fullest, forcing you to transform.

Triggers. When your Hit Points are reduced below half your maximum, or when you see an ally reduced to 0 Hit Points, you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or transform into your Hybrid Form for up to 10 minutes. During that time you must attack the source of the damage. If you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, the transformation ends.

Planar Tear. For three nights each month the Planar Tear bathes the world in magical light. When it occurs you must make the same saving throw: on a failure you transform into your Hybrid Form, and on a success into your Animal Form, remaining transformed until morning.

When you revert to your normal form after an Unwilling Transformation, you gain 1 level of Exhaustion. While transformed, you ignore all levels of Exhaustion.

When one of these triggers occurs, roll the appropriate saving throw using the activities on this feature; on a failure, use the Transform activity to assume your Hybrid Form.

Therianthrope DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.

Stage 2: Controlling the Curse

You have gained a small measure of control over the curse. You gain 1 Control Point, which you can spend to transform into your Animal Form as an Action using the activity on this feature. You regain all expended Control Points when you finish a Long Rest. Your Control Point maximum increases as you gain Stages (as shown in the Control Points column of the Advancement Table).

A Controlled Transformation lasts a number of hours equal to half your Stage (rounded down). It ends early if you are reduced to 0 Hit Points or if you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. When the duration would expire, you can spend 1 additional Control Point to extend it by the same duration. Reverting from any transformation inflicts 1 level of Exhaustion; while transformed you ignore all Exhaustion.

Stage 2: Wild Regeneration

While transformed, when you take damage that is not silvered, you can use your Reaction to harden your flesh and regenerate, regaining Hit Points equal to a roll of your Wild Regeneration die (see the Advancement Table).

Wild Regeneration is only available while you are in your Animal Form or Hybrid Form; the feature is part of those forms, not of your normal body. The Primal Vigour gift lets you use it while not transformed, and the Tapped Instinct gift grants its benefits for 1 minute.

Stage 3: Flaw Mitigation

Your growing mastery lets you blunt the curse's compulsions. This feature improves as you gain Stages:

  • Stage 3. When reduced below half your Hit Point maximum would trigger an Unwilling Transformation, you can instead spend 1 Control Point to transform via Controlled Transformation.
  • Stage 4. The above also applies when witnessing an ally reduced to 0 Hit Points.
  • Stage 5. During the Planar Tear you can spend 1 Control Point to automatically succeed on the saving throw, transforming into your Animal Form.
  • Stage 6. You have Advantage on the saving throw triggered by being reduced below half your Hit Point maximum.
  • Stage 7. You have Advantage on that save and on the save triggered by witnessing an ally reduced to 0 Hit Points.
  • Stage 8. An Unwilling Transformation no longer forces you to attack the damage's source.
  • Stage 9. At the end of each of your turns during an Unwilling Transformation you can repeat the saving throw, ending the transformation on a success.
  • Stage 10. You can choose to succeed on any saving throw against your Unwilling Transformation.

Stage 3: Bestial Aspect

Each branch grants a different Bestial Aspect:

  • Bear. While transformed, your keen sense of smell gives you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell and on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track creatures.
  • Fox. While transformed, your keen hearing and smell give you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
  • Raven. While transformed, your mimicry lets you imitate simple sounds and voices you have heard; a creature can tell the sound is imitation with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check against your Therianthrope DC.
  • Tiger. While transformed, your keen smell gives you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell and on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in natural terrain.
  • Shark. While transformed, your sensitivity to blood in the water gives you Blindsight with a range of 30 feet while you are underwater.
  • Snake. While transformed, your heat-sensing pits give you Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.
  • Wolf. While transformed, your keen hearing and smell give you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

Stage 4: Feral Speed

While transformed, your speed increases by 10 feet.

Stage 4: Empowered Transformation

Your transformations grow more potent:

  • Stage 4 (I). Your natural weapons count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical damage, except against other Therianthropes.
  • Stage 6 (II). Your signature attack deals extra damage equal to your Constitution modifier.
  • Stage 8 (III). The extra damage applies to all your natural weapon attacks while transformed. In addition, when you take the Attack action using Therianthrope natural weapons, you can make one additional natural weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

Stage 8: Predator's Resurgence

Once per Long Rest while not transformed, when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points you can use your Reaction to drop to 1 hit point instead, regain Hit Points equal to your Stage, and immediately trigger an Unwilling Transformation as though the damage source had reduced you below half your Hit Point maximum.

Transformation Rules

When you transform, you retain your Hit Points (current, maximum, and Temporary Hit Points), all of your ability scores, your proficiency bonus, your damage resistances, immunities, and vulnerabilities, your vision, and your biography and alignment unless the curse overrides them. Your saving throw and skill proficiencies merge with the form's; you use whichever is better for each roll.

While transformed, your key ability score is increased to your Key Ability value (see the Advancement Table) if it is not already higher. You take on your form's Armor Class, Speed, size, creature type (Beast), senses, and natural weapons.

You lose your languages, your gear proficiencies, your class features, your equipment, and your spellcasting while transformed, unless a gift says otherwise (Adorned Beast, Anchored Mind, or Hybrid Mastery).

Controlled Transformation offers your Animal Form only, unless you have the Hybrid Mastery gift. Reverting from any transformation inflicts 1 level of Exhaustion; while transformed you ignore all Exhaustion. The curse shifts your alignment while transformed to that of your branch.

Branches

Bear

Key Ability: Strength   Transformed Alignment: Chaotic Good

Forms

Werebear (Animal). Large Beast. AC 12 + your Constitution modifier. Speed 40 ft., Climb 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Bite (1d8 piercing; spreads the curse), Claws (2d4 slashing).

Werebear (Hybrid). Large Beast. AC 12 + your Constitution modifier. Speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Claw (2d4 slashing), Bite (1d10 piercing; spreads the curse).

Features

Bestial Aspect (Stage 3). While transformed, your keen sense of smell gives you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell and on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track creatures.

Ursine Grip (Stage 5). When you hit a creature with your Claw attack while transformed, that creature is also grappled (escape DC equals your Therianthrope DC). You can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

Enduring Hide (Stage 7). When you transform, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Stage plus your Constitution modifier.

Maul (Stage 9). Once per turn while transformed, when you hit the same creature with a second natural weapon attack in the same turn, the attack deals an extra 2d8 damage and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or have the Prone condition.

Milestones

  • Ursine Instincts (Stage 3). Succeed on 10 Perception or Survival checks.
  • Crushing Embrace (Stage 5). Grapple 5 different enemies.
  • Stoic Hide (Stage 7). Gain 50 Temporary Hit Points from Enduring Hide.
  • Bear's Maul (Stage 9). Deal an extra 30 damage to enemies with Maul.

Fox

Key Ability: Dexterity   Transformed Alignment: Chaotic Neutral

Forms

Werefox (Animal). Small Beast. AC 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Speed 40 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Bite (1d4 piercing; spreads the curse).

Werefox (Hybrid). Small Beast. AC 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Speed 45 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Claw (1d6 slashing), Bite (1d8 piercing; spreads the curse).

Features

Bestial Aspect (Stage 3). While transformed, your keen hearing and smell give you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

Cunning Escape (Stage 5). While transformed, you can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action.

Slippery (Stage 7). While transformed, opportunity attacks made against you have Disadvantage.

Ninefold Wiles (Stage 9). When you roll Initiative, you can use your Reaction to transform. If you would be Surprised, spending this Reaction prevents it. You cannot be Surprised while transformed.

Milestones

  • Vulpine Eyes (Stage 3). Succeed on 10 Perception checks.
  • Uncatchable (Stage 5). Disengage from 5 different enemies in melee.
  • Untouchable (Stage 7). Have 5 different enemies miss you with opportunity attacks.
  • Nine Lives (Stage 9). Transform using Ninefold Wiles 10 times.

Raven

Key Ability: Dexterity   Transformed Alignment: Lawful Good

Forms

Wereraven (Animal). Tiny Beast. AC 11 + your Dexterity modifier. Speed 10 ft., Fly 60 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Peck (1 piercing; spreads the curse).

Wereraven (Hybrid). Small Beast. AC 11 + your Dexterity modifier. Speed 25 ft., Fly 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Talon (1d6 slashing), Beak (1d6 piercing; spreads the curse).

Features

Bestial Aspect (Stage 3). While transformed, your mimicry lets you imitate simple sounds and voices you have heard; a creature can tell the sound is imitation with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check against your Therianthrope DC.

Ominous Gaze (Stage 5). When you hit a creature with a natural weapon attack while transformed, you can fix it with an ominous gaze. Until the end of your next turn, that creature has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against your Therianthrope DC.

Flyby (Stage 7). While transformed, you do not provoke opportunity attacks when you fly out of a creature's reach.

Death's Witness (Stage 9). When you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points while transformed, each enemy creature of your choice within 10 feet of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

Milestones

  • Corvid Cunning (Stage 3). Succeed on 10 Deception checks.
  • Doomed Gaze (Stage 5). Have 3 different enemy creatures fail a saving throw against your DC while affected by Ominous Gaze.
  • Winged Death (Stage 7). Perform 10 Flyby Strikes.
  • Herald of Ends (Stage 9). Affect 10 different enemy creatures with Death's Witness.

Tiger

Key Ability: Strength   Transformed Alignment: Neutral

Forms

Weretiger (Animal). Large Beast. AC 11 + your Dexterity modifier. Speed 40 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Claw (1d8 slashing), Bite (1d10 piercing; spreads the curse).

Weretiger (Hybrid). Medium Beast. AC 11 + your Dexterity modifier. Speed 40 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Claw (2d4 slashing), Bite (1d10 piercing; spreads the curse).

Features

Bestial Aspect (Stage 3). While transformed, your keen smell gives you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell and on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in natural terrain.

Pounce (Stage 5). While transformed, if you move at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hit it with a natural weapon attack, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or have the Prone condition.

Stalker's Prowl (Stage 7). While transformed, once per turn when you hit a creature with a natural weapon attack while you are hidden from it, the attack deals an extra 2d8 damage. At Stage 9 this extra damage increases to 2d12.

Apex Strike (Stage 9). While transformed, your natural weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. In addition, the extra damage from Stalker's Prowl increases to 2d12.

Milestones

  • Silent Prowl (Stage 3). Succeed on 10 Perception or Stealth checks.
  • First Pounce (Stage 5). Pounce on 5 different enemy creatures.
  • Ambush Predator (Stage 7). Deal 30 damage with Stalker's Prowl.
  • Apex Executioner (Stage 9). Score 5 critical hits against enemy creatures while transformed.

Shark

Key Ability: Strength   Transformed Alignment: Neutral Evil

Forms

Wereshark (Animal). Large Beast. AC 11 + your Constitution modifier. Speed 0 ft., Swim 40 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Bite (2d6 piercing; spreads the curse). Special traits: Water Breathing.

Wereshark (Hybrid). Large Beast. AC 11 + your Constitution modifier. Speed 30 ft., Swim 40 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Bite (2d6 piercing; spreads the curse), Claw (1d10 slashing). Special traits: Amphibious.

Features

Bestial Aspect (Stage 3). While transformed, your sensitivity to blood in the water gives you Blindsight with a range of 30 feet while you are underwater.

Blood Frenzy (Stage 5). While transformed, you have Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are below their Hit Point maximum.

Rending Bite (Stage 7). While transformed, when you hit a creature with your Bite, it cannot regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.

Feeding Frenzy (Stage 9). While transformed, when you deal damage with your Bite to a creature, you regain Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt.

Milestones

  • Hunter's Eye (Stage 3). Succeed on 10 Perception checks.
  • Feeding Frenzy (Stage 5). Hit 5 different enemy creatures while benefiting from Blood Frenzy.
  • Open Wounds (Stage 7). Affect 10 different enemies with Rending Bite.
  • Devour (Stage 9). Regain 30 Hit Points from enemies with Feeding Frenzy.

Snake

Key Ability: Dexterity   Transformed Alignment: Lawful Evil

Forms

Weresnake (Animal). Small Beast. AC 11 + your Dexterity modifier. Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Bite (1d4 piercing + 1d4 poison; spreads the curse).

Weresnake (Hybrid). Small Beast. AC 11 + your Dexterity modifier. Speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Bite (1d6 piercing + 1d4 poison; spreads the curse).

Features

Bestial Aspect (Stage 3). While transformed, your heat-sensing pits give you Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

Venomous Bite (Stage 5). While transformed, when you hit a creature with your Bite, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or have the Poisoned condition and take an extra 2d4 poison damage. At Stage 7 the extra damage increases to 2d6, and at Stage 9 to 2d8.

Shed Skin (Stage 7). While transformed, you can use a Bonus Action to end one effect on yourself that is grappling or restraining you or reducing your speed. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until that transformation ends.

Virulent Venom (Stage 9). While transformed, once per round when a creature fails the saving throw against your Venomous Bite, it takes the venom damage again at the start of its next turn.

Milestones

  • Serpent's Watch (Stage 3). Succeed on 10 Perception checks.
  • Venom in the Veins (Stage 5). Affect 5 different enemy creatures with Venomous Bite.
  • Shed the Old (Stage 7). Use Shed Skin against 3 different enemies.
  • Pitiless Poison (Stage 9). Affect 10 different enemy creatures with Virulent Venom.

Wolf

Key Ability: Strength   Transformed Alignment: Chaotic Evil

Forms

Werewolf (Animal). Medium Beast. AC 12 + your Dexterity modifier. Speed 40 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Bite (2d4 piercing; spreads the curse).

Werewolf (Hybrid). Medium Beast. AC 12 + your Dexterity modifier. Speed 40 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Attacks: Bite (1d8 piercing; spreads the curse), Claw (1d6 slashing).

Features

Bestial Aspect (Stage 3). While transformed, your keen hearing and smell give you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

Trip (Stage 5). While transformed, when you hit a creature with your Bite, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or have the Prone condition.

Pack Tactics (Stage 7). While transformed, you have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of it and that ally does not have the Incapacitated condition.

Alpha Howl (Stage 9). While transformed, you can use a Bonus Action to loose a commanding howl. Each ally of your choice within 30 feet that can hear you gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Stage and Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of your next turn.

Milestones

  • Wolf's Vigil (Stage 3). Succeed on 10 Perception checks.
  • Hamstring (Stage 5). Trip 5 different enemy creatures.
  • Pack Hunter (Stage 7). Hit 15 different enemies with attacks benefiting from Pack Tactics.
  • Voice of the Pack (Stage 9). Use Alpha Howl 10 times.

Milestones

You cannot gain a Stage while you have any Advancement Milestones. Milestone progress is tracked by you, not automatically: when your deeds satisfy one of your milestones, you complete it by deleting it, which marks it resolved and removes it from your sheet.

Your Path also grants branch milestones at Stages 3, 5, 7, and 9 (listed under each branch above); they gate your advancement exactly like the class milestones below.

Stage 1

  • Transformation: Wounded. Transform once after being reduced below half your Hit Point maximum.
  • Transformation: Ally Felled. Transform once after witnessing an ally reduced to 0 Hit Points.
  • Transformation: Planar Tear. Transform 3 times due to the Planar Tear.

Stage 2

  • Exert the Curse. Spend 10 Control Points.
  • Flesh That Knits. Mitigate a total of 30 damage using Wild Regeneration.
  • In addition, resolve one of the Callings below.

Stage 3

  • Seized Reins. Take control of an Unwilling Transformation 3 times.

Stage 4

  • Seized Reins II. Take control of an Unwilling Transformation 5 times.
  • Bound of the Beast. Travel 80 feet in one turn while transformed during Initiative.
  • In addition, resolve one of the Callings below.

Stage 5

  • Calm in the Tear. Spend 3 Control Points to automatically succeed on saving throws during the Planar Tear.

Stage 6

  • Mark of the Curse. Hit 10 different enemy creatures with your Bite.
  • Iron Will. Succeed on 5 saving throws to resist Unwilling Transformation (any trigger).
  • In addition, resolve one of the Callings below.

Stage 7

  • Iron Will II. Succeed on 10 saving throws to resist Unwilling Transformation (any trigger).

Stage 8

  • Overwhelming Fury. Make 10 extra attacks with Empowered Transformation III.
  • Death Defied. Trigger Predator's Resurgence once.
  • In addition, resolve one of the Callings below.

Stage 9

  • Tamed Terror. End an Unwilling Transformation 5 times.

Stage 10

  • In addition, resolve one of the Callings below.

Callings and Gifts

At Stages 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 you are offered a pair of Calling milestones: Control and Embrace. Callings are milestones like any other and must be resolved before you can advance; completing the Calling you choose removes the alternative permanently.

Each completed Calling grants you one gift. Stages 2 and 4 offer Minor gifts, Stages 6 and 8 offer Minor and Major gifts, and Stage 10 offers Minor, Major, and Grand gifts. A Grand gift requires at least two Minor and two Major gifts of the same Calling, which means committing to the same Calling at Stages 2, 4, 6, and 8 and choosing Major gifts at Stages 6 and 8 to claim a Grand gift at Stage 10.

Control Gifts

  • True Mastery (Grand). You have mastered the curse. Unwilling Transformation triggers only from the Planar Tear; you never gain Exhaustion from transforming; you can use Controlled Transformation as a Bonus Action; and your maximum number of Control Points increases by 1.
  • Anchored Mind (Major). You retain your languages, proficiencies, and class features during Controlled Transformation. You still cannot cast spells that require Somatic components.
  • Hybrid Mastery (Major). Your Hybrid Form becomes an option for Controlled Transformation. Because the Hybrid Form has the physique for it, you can benefit from attuned magic items and their properties while transformed; you still cannot use any item your current form lacks the physique to use.
  • Tapped Instinct (Major). While not transformed, you can spend 1 Control Point as a Bonus Action to heighten your body's capabilities for 1 minute, gaining the benefits of Bestial Aspect, Wild Regeneration, and Feral Speed.
  • Tireless Beast (Major). You no longer gain a level of Exhaustion when a Controlled Transformation ends.
  • Adorned Beast (Minor). When you use Controlled Transformation, your equipment continues to be worn if your new form could physically wear it. You cannot benefit from magic items through this feature unless you also have the Hybrid Mastery gift.
  • Careful Control (Minor). Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you regain 1 spent Control Point.
  • Extended Form (Minor). Your Controlled Transformation lasts a number of hours equal to your Stage instead of half your Stage.
  • Growing Control (Minor). Your maximum number of Control Points increases by 1.

Embrace Gifts

  • Beast Within (Grand). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. While not transformed, you gain the benefits of your Key Ability increase, all of your form's natural weapons, Feral Speed, and all Empowered Transformation bonuses. While transformed and below half your Hit Point maximum but above 0 Hit Points, you regain 10 Hit Points at the start of each of your turns.
  • Cursed Fury (Major). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to attack rolls with natural weapons.
  • Primal Vigour (Major). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. You can use Wild Regeneration while not transformed.
  • Swift Hunt (Major). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. The speed bonus from Feral Speed is doubled.
  • Thick Hide (Major). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to your Armor Class.
  • Animal Rage (Minor). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. Choose one natural weapon from your Hybrid Form; you gain access to it while not transformed.
  • Press the Hunt (Minor). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. The first time each turn that you deal damage with a natural weapon, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down).
  • Ravenous Regeneration (Minor). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. Wild Regeneration heals an extra amount equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down).
  • Savage Hunger (Minor). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. Once per turn while transformed, when you hit with a natural weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 1d6 damage.
